verdict.rationale: The Lambda Cloud API is a documented REST API published under a versioned path (cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json), which implies a versioning scheme. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or versioning guarantees, so only half the story is even implied. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning/compatibility guarantees, changelog or sunset notices, independent corroboration.
